burnPanel.hintZip:
All three options contain the same images from the PACS.

• STUDY (ZIP): A single .zip file is downloaded.
• DICOM ISO: A CD image to burn that includes image files and viewers.
• K-PACS ISO: A disc image specific to Windows.
burnPanel.hintZipAria: How STUDY ZIP, OHIF ISO, and K-PACS ISO folder layouts differ
